name: @mediajel/assistant-api
description: The Integrations Assistant's server side, as a NestJS app. Everything of substance lives in src/features/integrations-assistant — a self-contained feature module shaped to be lifted into amplication-nestjs-microservices' external-service, where main.ts and app.module.ts here are thrown away.
//node: Nest's DI needs emitDecoratorMetadata, so this builds with tsc (not bun's runtime). The repo pins Node 22 in .nvmrc — see apps/extension/README.md for why newer breaks the extension's watcher.
